info.name: Dehb
info.description: Dehb Web API requests grouped by service. Set host-name to the API root URL including http:// or https://, without a trailing slash. Default matches the http launch profile. Examples use SQLite sample data; run requests individually, as mutations can invalidate other examples. See docs/postman/README.md for setup.

variable.description: API root URL including scheme, without a trailing slash; for example http://localhost:7199.
